title: 第1章 秦政
content_zh:
天蒙蒙亮，露珠点缀在花草上随风摇曳。

大炎帝国，东海王府玉莲院中，一袭青衣的秦政站在玉莲花池旁，怔怔出神。

“这都第三百次了，为什么会这样。”

“我秦政一生都要滞留在武道最低级境界的肉身武境吗？”

“三百次不行，那就四百次，四百次不行，就五百次。”

发呆的秦政眼中泛起坚定之色，他那股子永不服输的劲儿，那一条道走到黑都不回头的性格让他在反复三百次经历之后，仍没有就此罢休的念头。

冷静下来，他回转身，开始打扫玉莲院。

这是他的职责，因为他是东海王府的奴仆。

秦政的父亲是已故老东海王的贴身仆人，为救老东海王而亡，故而地位还算不错，也正因为此，在老东海王临终前，指定他来管理这玉莲院的，当然秦政也是身兼多职，比如玉莲院总管和小厮，任务还是很艰巨的，因为现如今的玉莲院只有他一个人。

麻利的打扫完玉莲院，秦政便离开了东海王府。

神武大陆，以武为尊，武道修炼需有武脉，唯有拥有武脉之人方可突破肉身境界，沟通天地之力，淬炼己身，熔炼出真元，与天地合，突破人类桎梏，成为与日月同在的神，而没有武脉，将会永久的滞留在肉身境界，难有作为。

武脉是身体内储存力量的地方，也是人与天地之力沟通的桥梁。

他注定是没有成就，但是作为东海王府中人，他却早就坚定武道之心，从未动摇，哪怕是肉身境界冲击力武境三百次失败，仍未曾放弃，盖因东海王府乃是神武大陆三大帝国之一大炎帝国最强大的家族之一，是一个奴仆小婢都修有武道的地方，更是目睹一些武道强者无上风姿，听过许多的武道神话，逆天伐神之类的传说，如此环境熏陶，注定他不会甘于做个普通人。

而能够如此执着，还有一个原因，便是秦政的血。

“旁人没有武脉，只能滞留在肉身境界，无法达到力武境，而我不同。”

“我三百次突破肉身境界，达到力武境，却又三百次跌落回归肉身境界，这是一点不同。”

“再有每次跌落境界，那修炼出来的力量都是洗练我的血。”

“我的血，嗯，再次突破跌落回来，想来燕听雨应可验证是否每次突破，都是有内在变化的了。”

燕听雨是一名不折不扣的武道炼兵师，而且打造兵器的手法极其独特，同样的材料，她打造出来的兵器要远远胜过其他的炼兵师，成为神武大陆第一炼兵师则是燕听雨一生的梦想。

秦政带着紧张，期待的心情来到大炎帝都东南角一个小院内。

小院很干净，风吹过，花香沁人心脾。

就见黑发白裙的燕听雨正坐在客厅台阶前，双手托腮，做沉思状，与这雅致小院相映成趣，如画中人物。

听到脚步声，燕听雨见是秦政，一双妙目登时亮了起来，迅速的跳起来，飞奔至秦政的面前，“终于把你等来了，没有你的血让我都没兴趣再去炼兵了，嗯，你现在应该三百次突破了吧。”

“是啊，三百次了。”秦政没有隐瞒，关于他没有武脉，还能够突破再跌落回来的事情，也只有他们两人知晓。

“你的速度还真快啊，上次突破距离现在好像只有十三天吧。”燕听雨那一笑就好似月牙的眸子亮晶晶的，很是可爱。

“一百次之后，每次修炼速度都会缩短一些时间。”秦政感慨的道，“若是我能够不跌落境界的话该多好啊。”

燕听雨掩嘴笑道：“要是那样，别人就要自杀了，你这速度，若有武脉，估计现在这年龄都够达到当代东海王的实力了吧。”

早就准备妥当的燕听雨熟练的催动炼兵炉，投入材料，这些材料都是炼制普通兵器的普通材料，只为验证秦政的血。

秦政则在旁边观看着，等待着燕听雨的吩咐，要滴一滴血进入其中，塑造兵器。

“第二百九十八次突破的时候，无意中血入燕听雨的炼兵炉，而令她炼出来的兵器更胜往昔。”

“第二百九十九次突破之后，一滴血对兵器的加持，再攀全新高峰。”

“不知这第三百次突破又跌落境界，会带来怎样的变化。”

看着那炼兵炉，秦政那历经三百次打击，早就已沉稳的心，再一次的紧张起来，很难平静下来。

炼兵炉高不过一米左右，雕刻着一些奇异的花纹，三足驻地，炉盖被打开，散发出一股股的淡蓝色的光芒，燕听雨在那淡蓝色光芒映照之下，更显得出尘脱俗，她炼制兵器，每一个动作都是那般的浑然天成，仿似与炼兵炉合一了。

没过多久，燕听雨道：“做好准备。”

只见内里有一道旋转着的如同涡旋的火焰好似岩浆，这火是淡蓝色的，那涡旋的中心则有一道时而化作长剑，时而化作利刀的不定型的金属水，那便是燕听雨要炼制的兵器。

虽说秦政的血对炼制兵器有助力，但也有个前提，必须是血中精华，并非他所有的血都可以的，这是与燕听雨经过多次试验得到的结论。

血远离炼兵炉的时候，就是很普通的血珠似的，可一旦进入炼兵炉，遭遇到火焰的煅烧，这一滴血立刻发生了些许的变化。

原本猩红的血珠渐渐变透明，内里甚至有着一些模糊的影子。

他们仔细去看，很模糊，看不清晰。

血滴落在那金属水内，发出泉水叮咚的响声。

两者一接触，那金属水顿时发生变化。

原本就是时而为剑，时而为刀，可以说刀枪剑戟都不时地闪现，当血滴落入，金属水登时便化作一个模糊的人。

“三百次突破之后，你的血好像发生了质变。”

秦政很清楚，他三百次修炼失败，三百次洗练血脉，应该是带来了质变！
content_en:
The sky is bright and dewdrops are dotted on the flowers and grass and swaying in the wind.

In the Great Yan Empire, in the Jade Lotus Courtyard of the East China Sea Palace, Qin Zheng, dressed in green, stood beside the Jade Lotus Pond, in a daze.

"This is the three hundredth time, why is this happening?"

"Will I, Qin Zheng, have to stay in the physical martial arts realm, which is the lowest level of martial arts, for the rest of my life?"

"If three hundred times doesn't work, then four hundred times. If four hundred times doesn't work, then five hundred times."

Qin Zheng, who was in a daze, had a look of determination in his eyes. His determination to never admit defeat and his character that he would never look back even after going all the way made him still have no idea of giving up after experiencing it three hundred times.

After calming down, he turned around and started cleaning the Jade Lotus Courtyard.

This is his duty because he is a slave of Donghai Palace.

Qin Zheng's father was the personal servant of the late old Donghai King. He died to save the old Donghai King, so his status was pretty good. Because of this, before the old Donghai King died, he was appointed to manage the Jade Lotus Courtyard. Of course, Qin Zheng also held many positions, such as the manager and the servant of the Jade Lotus Courtyard. The task was still very difficult, because he was the only one in the Jade Lotus Courtyard now.

After cleaning the Jade Lotus Courtyard quickly, Qin Zheng left the East China Sea Palace.

In the Shenwu Continent, martial arts are respected, and martial arts cultivation requires martial arts. Only those with martial arts can break through the physical realm, communicate with the power of heaven and earth, temper their bodies, smelt out true essence, merge with heaven and earth, break through the shackles of human beings, and become gods who coexist with the sun and the moon. Without martial arts, they will stay in the physical realm forever, and it is difficult to achieve anything.

Martial pulse is the place where strength is stored in the body, and it is also the bridge between man and the power of heaven and earth.

He is destined to have no achievements, but as a member of the East China Sea Palace, he has long been determined in martial arts and has never wavered. Even if he failed three hundred times in the physical realm and the martial arts realm, he has never given up. Because the Donghai Palace is one of the three great empires of the Shenwu Continent, the Great Yan EmperorOne of the most powerful families in the country is a place where all the slaves and maids have practiced martial arts. He has witnessed the supreme grace of some martial arts masters, heard many martial arts myths, and legends about defying heaven and defeating gods. With such an environment, it is destined that he will not be willing to be an ordinary person.

Another reason for being so persistent is Qin Zheng's blood.

"Others don't have martial arts, so they can only stay in the physical realm and cannot reach the martial arts realm, but I am different."

"I broke through the physical realm three hundred times and reached the martial arts realm, but fell back to the physical realm three hundred times. This is a bit different."

"Besides, every time I fall into a realm, the power I cultivate is the blood that cleanses me."

"My blood, um, broke through again and fell back. I think Yan Tingyu should be able to verify whether there are internal changes every time there is a breakthrough."

Yan Tingyu is an out-and-out martial arts weapon refiner, and her method of forging weapons is extremely unique. Using the same materials, the weapons she forges are far superior to other weapon refiners. It is Yan Tingyu's lifelong dream to become the number one weapon refiner in the Shenwu Continent.

Qin Zheng came to a small courtyard in the southeast corner of Emperor Yan's capital with a nervous and expectant mood.

The courtyard is very clean, the wind blows, and the fragrance of flowers is refreshing.

Yan Tingyu, with black hair and white skirt, was seen sitting in front of the steps of the living room, holding her chin in her hands, as if in deep thought. She looked like a character in a painting, contrasting with the elegant courtyard.

Hearing the footsteps, Yan Tingyu saw that it was Qin Zheng, and her eyes suddenly lit up. She quickly jumped up and rushed to Qin Zheng, "I finally waited for you. Without your blood, I have no interest in refining weapons. Well, you should have broken through three hundred times now."

"Yes, three hundred times." Qin Zheng did not hide it. Only the two of them knew that he had no martial arts and could break through and fall back.

"You're really fast. It seems like it's only been thirteen days since your last breakthrough." Yan Tingyu's smile was like a crescent moon, her eyes sparkling, very cute.

"After a hundred times, the training speed will be shortened every time." Qin Zheng said with emotion, "It would be great if I could not fall down."

Yan Tingyu covered her mouth and said with a smile: "If that were the case, others would have committed suicide. With your speed, if you had martial arts, you would probably be old enough to reach the strength of the contemporary King of the East China Sea at your current age."

Yan Tingyu, who had been prepared long ago, skillfully activated the weapon refining furnace and put in the materials. These materials were all ordinary materials for refining ordinary weapons, just to verify Qin Zheng's blood.

Qin Zheng was watching from the side, waiting for Yan Tingyu's instructions to put a drop of blood into it and shape the weapon.

"During the 298th breakthrough, blood accidentally entered Yan Tingyu's weapon-refining furnace, which made the weapons she made even better than before."

"After the 299th breakthrough, the blessing of a drop of blood on the weapon has reached a new peak."

"I wonder what kind of changes this 300th breakthrough and fall will bring."

Looking at the weapon refining furnace, Qin Zheng's heart, which had been calmed after three hundred blows, became nervous again and found it difficult to calm down.

The weapon-refining furnace is only about one meter high, and is engraved with some strange patterns. It stands on three legs, and the furnace cover is opened, emitting streams of light blue light. Yan Tingyu looks even more otherworldly under the light blue light. She refines weapons, and every movement is so natural, as if she is one with the weapon-refining furnace.

Not long after, Yan Tingyu said: "Be prepared."

Inside, there was a swirling flame like magma. The fire was light blue. In the center of the vortex was an amorphous metallic water that sometimes turned into a long sword and sometimes turned into a sharp knife. That was the weapon Yan Tingyu wanted to refine.

Although Qin Zheng's blood is helpful in refining weapons, there is a prerequisite. It must be the essence of the blood. Not all his blood can be used. This is the conclusion reached after many experiments with Yan Tingyu.

When the blood is far away from the weapon-refining furnace, it looks like ordinary blood beads. But once it enters the weapon-refining furnace and encounters the calcining of the flames, this drop of blood immediately undergoes some changes.

The originally scarlet blood beads gradually became transparent, and there were even some vague shadows inside.

When they looked carefully, it was very blurry and they couldn't see clearly.

The blood dropped into the metal water, making a tinkling sound.

As soon as the two come into contact, the metallic water changes immediately.

Originally, it was sometimes a sword, sometimes a knife. It can be said that swords, guns, swords and halberds flashed from time to time. When blood drops fell into it, the metal water turned into a blurry person.

"After three hundred breakthroughs, your blood seems to have undergone a qualitative change."

Qin Zheng knew very well that his three hundred failed attempts at cultivation and his three hundred attempts at refining his bloodline should have brought about a qualitative change!
